title: DCSS 1st Grade ELA Pacing Calendar 2026-27

[Nov 30–Dec 4; Unit 3 header] Nov 30–Dec 4 │ Unit 3: The Underwater World │ Module 2, Sessions 11–15 │ Heggerty Week 15
[Nov 30–Dec 4; I Can] I can read and write contractions.
[Nov 30–Dec 4; I Can] I can explain how animals in the food chain are connected.
[Nov 30–Dec 4; I Can] I can identify facts about how squid look, move, and survive by reading an informational text.
[Nov 30–Dec 4; I Can] I can use the verbs is and are.
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Monday 30; Phonics row] Three-Letter Consonant Blends scr-, spl-
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Tuesday 1; Phonics row] Three-Letter Blends scr-, spl-; Beginning Blends br-, gr-
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Wednesday 2; Phonics row] Three-Letter Blends spr-, str-
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Thursday 3; Phonics row] Beginning Blends sn-, sw-
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Monday 30; High-Frequency Words row] all, small, their, through
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Tuesday 1; Vocabulary row] flow, plankton, hungrier
[Nov 30–Dec 4; Wednesday 2; Vocabulary row] squid, flap
[Dec 7–11; Unit 3 header] Dec 7–11 │ Unit 3: The Underwater World │ Module 2, Sessions 16–18; Module 3, Sessions 19–20 │ Heggerty Week 16
[Dec 7–11; I Can] I can read and write contractions with not.
[Dec 7–11; I Can] I can view a diagram to describe and compare ocean zones using words such as deeper, darkest, and different.
[Dec 7–11; I Can] I can use pronouns they and them.
